description: This file contains unit tests for the ShareToAgentDeepLink functionality, verifying message building, URL encoding, parsing, and settings persistence related to sharing content via deep links in an iOS app.

classes.name: ShareToAgentDeepLinkTests
classes.description: A test suite containing multiple test cases for sharing deep link functionality.

methods.name: buildMessageIncludesSharedFields
methods.description: Verifies that the message built includes the shared fields such as title, URL, text, and instruction.

methods.name: buildURLEncodesAgentRoute
methods.description: Tests URL encoding of the payload and parsing of the deep link to verify correct URL formation.

methods.name: buildURLReturnsNilWhenPayloadEmpty
methods.description: Checks that building a URL with an empty payload returns nil, ensuring proper handling of empty inputs.

methods.name: shareInstructionSettingsRoundTrip
methods.description: Ensures that saving and loading default share instructions works correctly, maintaining data integrity.
